# Game Idea: Pixel Escape

A simple endless runner where the player controls a pixel‑size square that automatically moves forward across a scrolling, procedurally‑generated terrain. The player can jump or slide to avoid obstacles (spikes, gaps, moving blocks). The canvas renders the terrain and obstacles in flat colors. The game ends (lose condition) when the square collides with any obstacle or falls into a gap. The score increases with distance traveled.

1: // Simple endless runner for <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
8: 
9:   // Game constants
10:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
11:   const JUMP_VEL = -12;
12:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
13:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
14:   const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
15: 
16:   let frame = 0, score = 0, gameOver = false;
17: 
18:   // Helper: draw background gradient and ground line
19:   function drawBackground() {
20:     // Sky gradient
21:     const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
22:     sky.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
23:     sky.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // pale turquoise
24:     ctx.fillStyle = sky;
25:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
26:     // Ground
27:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
28:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - 10, W, 10);
29:   }
30: 
31:   const player = {
32:     x: 50,
33:     y: H - PLAYER_SIZE - 10, // above ground
34:     vy: 0,
35:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
36:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
37:     sliding: false,
38:     jump() { if (this.onGround()) this.vy = JUMP_VEL; },
39:     slide(val) { this.sliding = val; },
40:     onGround() { return this.y >= H - this.height - 10; },
41:     update() {
42:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
43:       this.y += this.vy;
44:       if (this.y > H - this.height - 10) { this.y = H - this.height - 10; this.vy = 0; }
45:       // slide reduces height
46:       this.height = this.sliding ? PLAYER_SIZE / 2 : PLAYER_SIZE;
47:     },
48:     draw() {
49:       // Rounded player with outline
50:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
51:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
52:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
53:       const r = 4;
54:       ctx.beginPath();
55:       ctx.moveTo(this.x + r, this.y);
56:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width - r, this.y);
57:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.width, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + r);
58:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height - r);
59:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height, this.x + this.width - r, this.y + this.height);
60:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + r, this.y + this.height);
61:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height, this.x, this.y + this.height - r);
62:       ctx.lineTo(this.x, this.y + r);
63:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y, this.x + r, this.y);
64:       ctx.closePath();
65:       ctx.fill();
66:       ctx.stroke();
67:     }
68:   };
69: 
70:   const obstacles = [];
71:   function spawnObstacle() {
72:     const types = ['spike', 'gap'];
73:     const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
74:     if (type === 'spike') {
75:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
76:       obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - size - 10, w: size, h: size, type: 'spike' });
77:     } else {
78:       const gapWidth = 40 + Math.random() * 40;
79:       obstacles.push({ x: W + gapWidth, y: H, w: gapWidth, h: H, type: 'gap' });
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   function updateObstacles() {
84:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
85:       const o = obstacles[i];
86:       o.x -= SCROLL_SPEED;
87:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
88:     }
89:     if (frame % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
90:   }
91: 
92:   function drawObstacles() {
93:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
94:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
95:         // Draw triangle spike
96:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f33';
97:         ctx.beginPath();
98:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
99:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
100:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
101:         ctx.closePath();
102:         ctx.fill();
103:       }
104:       // gaps are invisible
105:     });
106:   }
107: 
108:   function checkCollision() {
109:     for (const o of obstacles) {
110:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
111:         if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.width > o.x &&
112:             player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.height > o.y) {
113:           return true;
114:         }
115:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
116:         if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.width > o.x && player.onGround()) {
117:           return true;
118:         }
119:       }
120:     }
121:     return false;
122:   }
123: 
124:   function loop() {
125:     if (gameOver) {
126:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
127:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
128:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
129:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
130:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
131:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2 - 10);
132:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
133:       return;
134:     }
135:     drawBackground();
136:     player.update();
137:     updateObstacles();
138:     player.draw();
139:     drawObstacles();
140:     if (checkCollision()) gameOver = true;
141:     score = Math.floor(frame / 10);
142:     // Score UI
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
144:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
145:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
146:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
147:     frame++;
148:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149:   }
150: 
151:   // Sound setup
152:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
153:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
154:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
155:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
156:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
157:     osc.type = 'square';
158:     gain.gain.value = 0.1;
159:     osc.connect(gain);
160:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
161:     osc.start();
162:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
163:   }
164: 
165:   // Input handling
166:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
167:     if (e.code === 'Space') {
168:       player.jump();
169:       playTone(400, 0.1); // jump sound
170:     }
171:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.slide(true);
172:   });
173:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
174:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.slide(false);
175:   });
176: 
177:   // Play game over sound once
178:   function playGameOverSound() {
179:     playTone(150, 0.4);
180:   }
181: 
182:   // Modify loop to trigger sound on game over
183:   const originalLoop = loop;
184:   function loop() {
185:     if (gameOver) {
186:       // Ensure sound plays only once
187:       if (!loop.gameOverSoundPlayed) {
188:         playGameOverSound();
189:         loop.gameOverSoundPlayed = true;
190:       }
191:     }
192:     originalLoop();
193:   }
194: 
195:   loop();
196: })();

(End of file - total 196 lines)
</content>
